questions.question: Is audit mandatory for LLP?
questions.answer: Audit is only mandatory if turnover exceeds ₹40 Lakhs or contribution exceeds ₹25 Lakhs.

questions.question: Can an LLP convert to Pvt Ltd?
questions.answer: Yes, but the process is complex. It is better to start as Pvt Ltd if you plan to raise funds.
